Name: Magbish
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed sites include Khirbet el Makhbiyeh and Khirbet Qanan Mugheimis
Description: A place whose 156 returning children are counted in Ezra's list of the exiles who came back with Zerubbabel.
BiblicalSignificance: Magbish survives as a number in a homecoming list: 156 people whose town is otherwise lost to us.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
